scripts.deploy: npm run build:lambdas && sam build -t infra/template.yaml && sam deploy
scripts.test: npm run validate:mocks && npx tsx --test packages/risk-core/test/risk.test.ts
scripts.verify:p1: npm run typecheck && echo 'P1: type-check passed'
scripts.verify:p2: npm run validate:mocks && sam validate -t infra/template.yaml && echo 'P2: mocks + SAM template OK'
scripts.verify:p3: npm run typecheck && echo 'P3: type-check passed'
scripts.verify:p4: npm run test && echo 'P4: risk-core tests passed'
